problem: Old development snapshot did not collect programs/core/platform_capabilities; restore incorrectly required it while already retaining current Core as the local maintenance adapter. The generic missing-build message hid the actual component.
fix: Only for an old development package using the current Core adapter, retain the registered current capability catalog with an explicit local_capability_adapter report check
A modern package missing its catalog or an unavailable current adapter catalog still fails before overwrite
File-copy errors identify source and target and preserve the underlying filesystem cause instead of incorrectly demanding a build

cases: Legacy missing catalog preserves current catalog and reports compatibility scope
Legacy package with a catalog restores its historical bytes
Legacy package with unavailable current catalog fails
Missing Web input names source and destination and removes prepared temporary files

native_scope: Owned PostgreSQL, Redis, Core and Web; uses the actual old Core artifact from A, fixture business records and a package without a capability catalog. Does not overwrite the user daily database or execute actual production plugins.
limits: Legacy adapter compatibility is local development data recovery, not byte-for-byte replay of historical Core and capability catalog
Production and Linux full recovery are not accepted by this run
